transcript: The long winter ended, the snow melted, the fields and hills gradually recovered. The earth was awake, the air felt pleasant, cherry trees were full of flowers. As I walked along the river, my heart became calm. My face grew gentle, the world itself seemed new On the path I met a friend She looked more mature than last year Yet her smile remained the same Her eyes shone brightly, her voice sounded warm Children's voices reached me And I felt full of pleasure and delight A fresh hope arose in my heart A small joy emerged in my chest At night I remained awake Everything was quietly but surely becoming new The spring was young the world seemed alive

segments.text: The long winter ended, the snow melted, the fields and hills gradually recovered.
The earth was awake, the air felt pleasant, cherry trees were full of flowers.
As I walked along the river, my heart became calm.
My face grew gentle, the world itself seemed new
On the path I met a friend
She looked more mature than last year
Yet her smile remained the same
Her eyes shone brightly, her voice sounded warm
And I felt full of pleasure and delight
A fresh hope arose in my heart
A small joy emerged in my chest
Everything was quietly but surely becoming new
